notes.title: Pixel Mayhem! bundle now live!
notes.content:
[h2]Long time no see, heroes![/h2]

We come bearing exciting news. As a commemoration of our longstanding partnership between Electric Monkeys and PQube, we have created [b]a permanent Steam bundle for Gravity Heroes and When the Light Dies[/b], our new gothic horror survival roguelite which launched into Early Access today. 

[b]The Pixel Mayhem! bundle has a 60% discount[/b] and owners of one game in the bundle will be able to purchase the other to get this discount: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39260/Pixel_Mayhem/

This bullet-spraying, horde-slaying bundle includes both the gothic horror survivors like When the Light Dies and the gravity-shifting co-op shooter Gravity Heroes, a fast-paced, chaotically beautiful 2D platform shooter fuelled by retro arcade nostalgia with an electrifying soundtrack and popping pixel art style!

[b]Check out the launch trailers for both games below: [/b]

[previewyoutube=F6haafMkBtk;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=lT6VgebBtI4;full][/previewyoutube]

Join us in celebrating our longstanding partnership and get your hands on the Pixel Mayhem! Bundle for the ultimate discount!

Electric Monkeys & PQube

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - New features, bug fixes, and Japanese language added
Gravity Heroes - Out NOW on Consoles!
notes.content:
Take on the robotic hordes on the walls, floors, and ceilings as you shift and control your centre of gravity with Gravity Heroes' unique 'gravity shifter’ mechanic. Dodge enemy projectiles, meet enemies head-on landing on walls and ceilings or simply navigate around each stage by shifting your gravity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/895681e22aefa7e5987addb2d9048bc07774f75b.png[/img]
With an incredible pixel art aesthetic, classic arcade-style platform shooting combined with the unique 'gravity shifter' mechanic, Gravity Heroes is a unique combination of retro style and modern mechanics that push the boundaries.
 
Launched to PC in February, Gravity Heroes is also available now on Steam! Described by players as featuring "skilful gameplay is as beautiful as the graphics".

[h3][b]Watch the Launch Trailer below:[/b][/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lT6VgebBtI4
Step into the arena as a member of the Gravity Heroes, taking on hordes of synthetic enemies as you attempt to restrike the balance between man and machine in a futuristic war-torn world.
 
Your ultimate weapon is the 'Gravity Shifter', allowing you to manipulate gravity; use your unique abilities to cut down enemies, collect power-ups, new weapons and switch up tactics to change the tide of battle.
 
[h3][b]Available now on Steam and consoles![/b]
[/h3]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1020310/Gravity_Heroes/

notes.title: Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/4d8901d11b84430997d9cc4e9e916b3f9e38f699.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Hey there, Heroes![/b][/h3]

We're proud to finally announce that the chaotic, 2D Platform shooter 'Gravity Heroes' is out [b]now[/b]!!
Pick up your copy today, and enjoy a [b]10% launch-special discount when you do[/b].

[b]What is Gravity Heroes?[/b]
Take on the robotic hordes on the walls, floors, and ceilings as you shift and control your centre of gravity with Gravity Heroes's unique 'gravity shifter’ mechanic. Dodge enemy projectiles, meet enemies head-on landing on walls and ceilings or simply navigate around each stage by shifting your gravity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/de9bf5db9628b5ac5925137611e878395dcce58f.png[/img]

[b]Discover The reason Behind a Robotic Uprising[/b]
Take your place as a member of the 'Gravity Heroes' as you investigate the mysterious reason behind a broken peace treaty between humans and robotic-beings called synthetics in Story mode. Play solo or team up with up to three friends as you take on synthetic hordes and colossal bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/f92ebf6ebc8262e80bb82822a84ea2ef7c997610.gif[/img]

[b]Team Up With, or Take On Friends[/b]
Get lost in hectic couch-based local multiplayer! Either team up with friends and family and take on the hordes in 'Survivor mode' or unleash your competitive side in 'versus mode'. Pick your character and strap in for hours of fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/390ce0ccbd83fdb31d350b5197a34cca9ada9522.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/4d8901d11b84430997d9cc4e9e916b3f9e38f699.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Character overview: Nala
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Steam friends![/h3]

We wanted to share some more information around one of the main character in Gravity Heroes! This week, we’re revealing a little bit more on Nala! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/390ce0ccbd83fdb31d350b5197a34cca9ada9522.gif[/img]

Nala is one of the four elite member that compose the Gravity Heroes Squad. She earned this position at a very young age as a brilliant scientist specialized in synthetic data and their history.

Nala is a very focused person and won't engage in Abel's jokes as she considers them a distraction. She goes along well with her colleagues but won't get too intimate with anyone as she prefers to be alone. 

Although Nala is very quiet, she has a strong conception of what is right and wrong and usually doesn't change her mind based on rumors. Often the reality mixes right and wrong in a greyish area, which will make her question her ideas and make her wondering if she is doing what is right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/6ed3cc0c77de6f0ec76250a83d0102250b4dcfc4.jpg[/img]

In Gravity Heroes, there are robots capable of reproducing themselves, thinking, and living in society. They are considered synthetic beings or simply synthetics.  Despite the laws of robotics that don't allow them to harm humans, there are groups of people that fear them and want to end their existence. 

Nala is part of the group that considers them legitimate beings and will defend their rights to be part of society. But this conception is in check since synthetics are being violent and harming humanity. Will Nala give them a chance to explain themselves? Or will she consider them enemies no matter what their motivation is?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/4d8901d11b84430997d9cc4e9e916b3f9e38f699.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development update - 26/10/2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/4d8901d11b84430997d9cc4e9e916b3f9e38f699.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hey Steam friends![/h3]

As the dev team is hard at work on Gravity Heroes, we wanted to provide you with a small update on where some of our efforts have gone! It's been a hectic few months with Gravity Heroes featuring in both the Steam Summer Festival and Tokyo Game Show, but we are always continuously working to make the game better and better. See below for the full update of what's changed! 

[list]
[i][*] Buff on the Bouncy Gun, increased damage, now it's not an advantage to keep the "default" gun.
[*] Fixed this issue: if the default language of the player's PC was not set to neither English nor Portuguese, the game would use Portuguese as default.
[*] Balanced some enemies to make the game more fair and challenging.
[*] Improved 2D illumination on the game. (image below)[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736504/a424824c19bbd405b4631366b156c6c238677b04.png[/img]

Are you interested in trying Gravity Heroes for yourself? Look no further, the demo is currently out now! Give it a download and let us know what you think on Twitter using #GravityHeroes. 

[b]What is Gravity Heroes? [/b]
Gravity Heroes is a fast paced, chaotically beautiful 2D platform shooter. Control your character's gravitational pull and fight hordes of robotic enemies on the ground, walls or ceiling. Fuelled by 80’s and 90’s nostalgia with an electrifying soundtrack and stylistically popping pixel art style, Gravity Heroes offers chaotic fun playing either by yourself or joined by up to three others locally.

[b]See our latest trailer!  [/b]
[previewyoutube=XncAsF_MKzw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New features available (version 0.3.14)
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dialogues: added on the beginning/end of the level
[*] Grenades: added force control
[*] Grenades: added aiming support
[*] Grenades: added trail color feedback
[*] Grenades: now respect the player's gravity
[*] Checkpoints: when restarting a boss level it's not necessary to solve the puzzle again
[*] Ghost: added feedback when getting hit
[*] Ghost: now when the ghost gets hit the energy is respawned in the level so it can recover the lost energy
[*] Versus: scoreboard redesigned to clarify the game result
[*] Balancing: enemies' life doesn't get higher when there are 3-4 players
[*] Bug Fixed: when a Stun Grenade hits an enemy it not always explode
[*] Bug Fixed: when shooting with Bounce Gun the shoots are inaudible
[/list]
